title: Phobos story data pack

priority.description: Override files only: files apply lowest first (default 0), so a higher number has a later word. Leave it out unless you need it.

notes.description: Free text for maintainers; ignored by the game.

broadcastShare.description: Share of TV news picks given to story broadcasts.

advertShare.description: Share of TV advert picks given to story adverts.

maxActiveArcs.description: How many arcs may start by themselves at once.

chatterShare.description: Share of matching small talk that uses a story line when one fits.

tipShare.description: Share of loading-screen tips taken from story tips.

localWeight.description: How much more often news and adverts of the place the player is at are picked (default 4; unplaced entries count 2).

farWeight.description: How much news and adverts of other places weigh (default 1; 0 hides them).

mentionDays.description: Game days after a news item was shown during which people still mention it (default 10).

title.description: For authors; the game does not show it.

notes.description: Free text for maintainers; ignored by the game.

region.description: Shown above the item as Region News, such as Outer System, Tharsis or Shipping & Inner System; left out, the place's own.

text.description: The news item. Plain text: no angle brackets, and no square brackets except the placeholders [player], [player-first], [ship], [place], [region], [station], [body], [date], [crew] and [person:key].

weight.description: How often it is picked against other story entries (default 1).

once.description: Shown once in a save, then never again.

mods.description: Mods that must be installed: a Phobos mod folder name such as PhobosManufacturing, or a BepInEx plugin id.

playerConditions.description: Game conditions the player must have.

forbidConditions.description: Game conditions the player must not have.

owns.description: Item definition ids that must be on one of the player's ships, such as PhobosVerdemorrowFirstlight4Installed.

items.description: A station registration id such as OKLG (its parts, such as VORB_HAB, count too), or any for any station.

dockedAt.description: Docked at or aboard any one of these stations.

arcsDone.description: Arcs the player must have finished.

arcsNotStarted.description: Arcs the player must never have started.

afterDays.description: Only once this many game days have passed since the player's story record began.

beforeDays.description: Only until this many game days have passed since the player's story record began.

filesRead.description: Story data files the player must have opened.

flags.description: Story flags that must all be set (an arc outcome sets them).

notFlags.description: Story flags none of which may be set.

arcsActive.description: Arcs that must be under way.

arcsAtStep.description: Arcs under way at a step, as arc.step.

places.description: Places the player must be at (any one): docked at it, or anywhere in its region for a regional place.

regions.description: Regional places the player must be in the region of (any one).

newsSeen.description: News items that must have been shown on a TV.

faction.description: The game's faction name, such as OKLGCorp.

atLeast.description: One of the game's standing tiers.

atMost.description: One of the game's standing tiers.

items.description: How a faction regards the player: at least and/or at most a tier.

standing.description: How the game's factions must regard the player; each must hold.

crewWith.description: Game conditions (skills among them) that someone aboard other than the player must have.

crewCount.description: How many crew the player has, the player not counted.

running.description: Phobos machines, by installed definition id, that must be running on one of the player's ships.

months.description: Calendar months the entry is for.

hours.description: A window of the day in UTC hours; from after to wraps midnight.

requires.description: When the entry may appear. Every part is optional and every part given must hold.

id.description: Unique within the arc; it names the goal in saves, so keep it once published.

from.description: Who it is from, shown before the text in the crew log; leave out when person names them.

person.description: The person it is from, shown as Name, role.

text.description: The message, shown in the crew log. Plain text: no angle brackets, and no square brackets except the placeholders [player], [player-first], [ship], [place], [region], [station], [body], [date], [crew] and [person:key].

bulletin.description: A broadcast id that the next TV news item shows.

delivery.description: What the player is told when the step begins.

title.description: The goal title in the GOALS list. Plain text: no angle brackets, and no square brackets except the placeholders [player], [player-first], [ship], [place], [region], [station], [body], [date], [crew] and [person:key].

description.description: The goal description. Plain text: no angle brackets, and no square brackets except the placeholders [player], [player-first], [ship], [place], [region], [station], [body], [date], [crew] and [person:key].

person.description: Whose face the goal shows and who it says it is from; left out, the sender of the step's letter, else the arc's last sender.

objective.description: A goal in the GOALS list. A step without one waits on its tests unseen.

station.description: dock-at only. A station registration id such as OKLG (its parts, such as VORB_HAB, count too), or any for any station. Left out, the arc's own place.

item.description: have-item and install only: an item definition id.

count.description: have-item and install only: how many (default 1).

consume.description: have-item only: the items are taken from the player when the step finishes.

hours.description: wait only: game hours since the step began.

amount.description: credits only: how many credits the player holds (taken when the step finishes, with consume).

condition.description: condition only: a game condition the player has, such as a skill (SkillHacking).

tests.description: All must pass for the step to finish.
